description:
2026TD450582 - [All level] AI Engineer (Computer Vision/NLP/LLM)
MB là một trong những ngân hàng hệ sinh thái Số dẫn đầu tại Việt Nam, với định hướng trở thành “Doanh nghiệp số, Tập đoàn tài chính dẫn đầu”, công nghệ tại MB hiện được thúc đẩy dựa trên 5 trụ cột cốt lõi: công nghệ mới, tự động hóa, dữ liệu, AI và con người. Tính đến năm 2026, ngân hàng đang được phục vụ gần 40 triệu khách hàng, xử lý hơn 12,4 tỷ giao dịch trên kênh Số. Hiện tại, chúng tôi đang tìm kiếm  cơ hội hợp tác cùng các ứng viên AI Engineer, Data Scientist, Machine Learning Engineer có năng lực chuyên môn sâu để gia nhập và phát triển các sản phẩm Số phục vụ quy mô người dùng lớn. Đây sẽ là cơ hội để Bạn thực hiện khát vọng phát triển những nền tảng ứng dụng AI tiên tiến cùng tiềm năng tạo ảnh hướng lớn đến cộng đồng cùng MB.
Mô tả công việc:
Nhân sự AI tại MB sẽ tham gia các dự án khác nhau tùy theo thế mạnh chuyên môn và nhu cầu phát triển năng lực của bản thân, có thể kể đến các mảng công việc sau:
1. Thiết kế và triển khai các giải pháp AI/ML toàn diện (end-to-end), như LLM, pipeline RAG, semantic search), AI Agent, chatbot, fraud detection.
2. Thiết kế và triển khai các giải pháp AI/ML trong lĩnh vực Thị giác máy tính (Computer Vision), bao gồm eKYC, OCR, segmentation, classification, camera AI.
3. Coding, test metrics, service và unit test theo mô hình DevOps, MLOps
4. Tích hợp và tối ưu hóa quy trình làm việc AI bằng các framework và công cụ như LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Hugging Face,...
5. Nghiên cứu và áp dụng các nghiên cứu mới ( SOTA) như Reinforcement Learning, Self-Supervised Learning và Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning...
Với nhóm ứng viên là sinh viên tài năng và fresher: yêu cầu tham gia các chương trình đào tạo và dự án mới tại MB để để phát triển lên các vị trí Kỹ sư cấp cao tại MB trong tương lai gần
requirements:
Học vấn:
Tốt nghiệp Đại học trở lên các chuyên ngành: Công nghệ thông tin, Khoa học máy tính, Kỹ thuật phần mềm, Hệ thống thông tin, Điện tử Viễn thông, Trí tuệ nhân tạo (AI), Khoa học dữ liệu hoặc các ngành liên quan.
Kiến thức và kỹ năng chuyên môn
:
Ứng viên cần có nển tảng chuyên môn tốt về một hoặc nhiều mảng sau:
1. Lập trình:
- Thành thạo một trong các ngôn ngữ: Python, C/C++.
- Có kinh nghiệm phát triển Backend Service/Microservices với các framework như FastAPI, Flask hoặc Django.
2. Machine Learning & Deep Learning
- Có kinh nghiệm sử dụng ít nhất 01 framework AI/ML phổ biến như: PyTorch, TensorFlow,...
- Nắm vững các mô hình và thuật toán Machine Learning/Deep Learning như: Supervised Learning, Reinforcement Learning; CNN, Transformer...
- Có kinh nghiệm về tối ưu mô hình: Knowledge Distillation, Model Pruning, Model Quantization, Inference Optimization...
3. AI Applications
Có kinh nghiệm nghiên cứu hoặc triển khai các bài toán về:
+  Computer Vision (CV), Image Processing, Video Analytics, eKYC, Document AI.
+ Natural Language Processing (NLP)
+ Speech/Audio Processing.
+ Fraud Detection
4. MLOps & AI Deployment
Có kinh nghiệm sử dụng:  Git, Docker, Kubernetes, MLflow, Kubeflow, TensorFlow Serving, Triton Inference Server

title: Middle AI Engineer (LLM, RAG, ML, Python, PyTorch)
address: Tầng 4 - Tòa nhà Lebuiding số 342 đường Mỹ Đình, Phường Từ Liêm, Tu Liem, Ha Noi
reasons:

description:
Thiết kế và xây dựng AI agents và ứng dụng LLM: gọi công cụ (tool/function calling), quy trình nhiều bước, đầu ra có cấu trúc (structured output), guardrails; đảm bảo độ tin cậy với retry, xử lý giới hạn tốc độ (rate limit) và kiểm tra an toàn.
Xây dựng hệ thống RAG và tìm kiếm tri thức trên tài liệu của khách hàng: chunking, embedding, hybrid search, reranking và câu trả lời có căn cứ.
Xây dựng pipeline document AI: OCR, trích xuất bố cục và bảng, tài liệu scan chất lượng thấp, mô hình thị giác-ngôn ngữ, kèm chấm điểm độ tin cậy và kiểm tra kết quả.
Triển khai và vận hành dịch vụ AI trên cloud (Azure, AWS) và trên VPS hoặc máy chủ tự quản: Docker, bảo mật, quản lý secrets và kiểm soát chi phí.
Chạy và tối ưu mô hình LLM, embedding, reranker: dùng API có sẵn hoặc mô hình mã nguồn mở trên GPU (vLLM, Ollama hoặc tương đương), áp dụng quantization và batching khi cần.
Đảm nhận MLOps và vận hành: CI/CD cho dịch vụ AI, quản lý phiên bản mô hình và dữ liệu, logging, tracing, giám sát hiệu năng và tài nguyên, tối ưu độ trễ và chi phí.
Xây dựng API và dịch vụ backend (REST, tác vụ bất đồng bộ, hàng đợi, xác thực) kết nối các thành phần AI với hệ thống của khách hàng.
Đo lường và cải thiện chất lượng: xây dựng bộ dữ liệu đánh giá (có thể gồm dữ liệu tổng hợp), dùng các chỉ số như Precision@K, Recall@K, và MRR, phân tích lỗi và tối ưu liên tục.
Thu thập yêu cầu của khách hàng, ước lượng công việc, viết tài liệu giải pháp.
Hỗ trợ đồng đội và phối hợp với frontend, BA, tester và quản lý dự án.
requirements:
Từ 2 năm kinh nghiệm AI/ML hoặc kỹ thuật phần mềm, đã triển khai ít nhất một hệ thống LLM, agent hoặc OCR đến người dùng thật.
Python vững, biết PyTorch hoặc thư viện ML tương đương, và thực hành kỹ thuật tốt (Git, kiểm thử, code review).
Từng xây dựng AI agents với API LLM (tool calling, framework điều phối hoặc tự viết) và một framework API như FastAPI.
Từng làm OCR và xử lý tài liệu (engine mã nguồn mở, dịch vụ OCR trên cloud hoặc mô hình thị giác-ngôn ngữ).
Có kinh nghiệm với vector database hoặc search engine (pgvector, FAISS hoặc tương đương) và hiểu hybrid search.
Kỹ năng triển khai: Linux, Docker, ít nhất một nền tảng cloud (Azure, AWS), cài đặt VPS, reverse proxy (Nginx hoặc tương đương), kiến thức cơ bản về mạng, bảo mật, quản lý secrets và phân quyền.
Hiểu cơ sở dữ liệu SQL.
Biết kiểm thử và đo lường chất lượng hệ thống AI bằng các chỉ số phù hợp.
Biết giao tiếp tiếng Anh là một lợi thế.
benefits:
Thu nhập cạnh tranh, chế độ tăng lương 1-2 lần/năm
Thưởng theo hiệu quả làm việc, thưởng Lễ Tết, Công đoàn vào 08/03, 20/10, Tết Thiếu nhi, Tết Trung thu,…
Tham gia các hoạt động Teambuilding, Nghỉ mát,…

title: [HCM] Middle/Senior AI Engineer (GenAI/LLM, English)
address: 02nd Floor, Etown 6 Cong Hoa, 364 Cong Hoa Street, Tan Binh, Ho Chi Minh
reasons:
Working in one of the Best Places to Work
Hybrid working and Flexible working hours
13th-month salary and Performance bonus
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE:
You will design, build and ship GenAI applications (LLM, RAG, AI agents) for our clients, from requirement to production. You work directly with English-speaking stakeholders and own your solutions end to end.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
Build and deploy LLM-based applications: RAG pipelines, multi-agent workflows, tool calling, document processing.
Design retrieval (hybrid search, vector databases, reranking) and evaluate quality with clear metrics.
Take features from prototype to production: APIs, deployment, monitoring, cost and latency tuning.
Work with clients to understand business needs, present results and align technical work with their goals.
Collaborate with Solution Architects, Data Scientists and Software Engineers in an Agile team.
requirements:
2+ years of hands-on AI/ML engineering experience, including LLM/GenAI applications running in production.
Strong Python; experience with frameworks such as LangChain/LangGraph, LlamaIndex or similar.
Experience with vector databases (Qdrant, pgvector, OpenSearch, Milvus…) and RAG design.
Able to show results: evaluation metrics, users served, latency or cost improvements.
Good spoken English for daily work with clients.
Bachelor's degree in CS, AI, Data Science or a related field (Master's is a plus).
Nice to have:
Fine-tuning (LoRA/QLoRA), self-hosted LLMs (vLLM), LLMOps.
Cloud deployment (AWS/Azure/GCP), Docker.
Computer vision or speech experience together with GenAI.
Please note:
this role focuses on building AI systems. Profiles that are mainly software engineering, data engineering or data analysis, with AI only as a side tool, will not match.
benefits:
Group benefit (Lunch support, Gasoline support).
Working days/week (From Monday to Friday).
2 days WFH/week.
Health, Social, and Unemployment Insurance (based on full contractual salary, according to Labor Code) and PVI Health Insurance, yearly health-checkup.
13th-month salary and performance bonus.
12 days annual leave plus extra 02 days of company leave and national holiday leaves.
Technical certificate fee support.
Project allowance if any.
Company trips, sponsored team building, monthly Happy Hour, Sports Clubs (Soccer, Badminton, Ping-Pong, Yoga), and other joyful events.

title: AI Engineer (LLM, Python, Docker, API, RAG)
address: 187 Nguyễn Lương Bằng , Ha Noi
reasons:
Thu nhập từ 24 - 26 tháng lương/năm
Được đào tạo trend công nghệ mới
Team building, year-end party...
description:
1. Phân tích bài toán và thiết kế giải pháp GenAI
Làm việc với các đơn vị nghiệp vụ để tiếp nhận yêu cầu, đánh giá khả năng ứng dụng GenAI và đề xuất hướng tiếp cận kỹ thuật phù hợp.
Phân tích bối cảnh sử dụng, dữ liệu đầu vào/đầu ra và rủi ro để thiết kế kiến trúc GenAI khả thi, an toàn.
Lựa chọn mô hình, nền tảng và phương thức triển khai (on-premise, private cloud, hybrid, API service) phù hợp với từng bài toán.
2. Phát triển và triển khai các dịch vụ GenAI
Thiết kế và triển khai giải pháp GenAI trên nền tảng mô hình mã nguồn mở hoặc dịch vụ API bên ngoài (ví dụ: OpenAI, Gemini hoặc tương đương), tuân thủ chính sách bảo mật và quản trị rủi ro của Ngân hàng.
Đóng gói ứng dụng GenAI thành dịch vụ (API/microservice) để tích hợp với hệ thống nghiệp vụ, cổng nội bộ và nền tảng số.
3. Phát triển giải pháp RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)

title: Agentic AI Engineer (LLM, Python)
company: CÔNG TY TNHH NEXLAB IT SOLUTIONS
address: Số 20 đường Sông Thao, Tan Son Hoa, Ho Chi Minh
description:
About Us
We are a cybersecurity company building AI-native security platforms that span both offensive and defensive operations:
Offensive Platform — An autonomous security platform that uses agentic AI to continuously penetration-test APIs, web applications, and cloud infrastructure. It validates vulnerabilities, chains attack paths, and generates audit-ready reports — all with human-in-the-loop safety
controls.
Defensive Platform — A role-based AI SOC platform where specialized agents (SOC Manager, Analyst, Incident Response, Threat Hunter) work as a coordinated crew to triage alerts, investigate incidents, hunt threats, and manage Detection-as-Code — at machine speed, under human oversight.
We are not building wrappers around ChatGPT. We are building autonomous, multi-step AI agent systems that reason, plan, use tools, and take real-world action in high-stakes security environments.
The Role
As an Agentic AI Engineer, you will design, build, and ship the autonomous AI agent systems at the core of our products. Depending on your background and interest, you'll work on one or both of the following:
Offensive Security Agents: You'll build the agent brain that plans multi-step attack strategies, generates auditable configuration files, orchestrates security tool execution (Nmap, Nuclei, Nessus, custom exploits), validates discovered vulnerabilities, and chains minor findings into critical attack paths — all within a human-in-the-loop approval framework.
Defensive Security Agents: You'll build the specialized SOC agents that autonomously triage and correlate alerts, enrich events with contextual data, summarize investigations, propose detection rules, execute threat hunting queries, and recommend incident response actions — while keeping analysts in control of final decisions.
What You'll Do
Design and implement autonomous agent architectures that handle multi-step reasoning, tool use, memory, and planning in production security workflows
Build reliable agent loops with proper error handling, retry logic, guardrails, and human-inthe-loop approval gates for high-risk actions
Develop dynamic tool-calling pipelines where agents select, configure, and orchestrate external security tools based on contextual analysis
Engineer prompt chains and agent reasoning strategies across multiple LLM providers (OpenAI, Google Vertex AI, Anthropic Claude) with model-agnostic abstractions
Build and maintain the context layer that gives agents awareness of users, assets, past incidents, typical behavior, and environmental state
Design evaluation frameworks to measure agent reliability, accuracy, and safety — especially for high-stakes actions like exploit execution or incident response recommendations
Collaborate with security engineers to translate offensive and defensive domain expertise into agent behavior, tool profiles, and decision logic
Optimize for latency, cost, and token efficiency in production agent workloads
Support on-premise deployments using self-hosted open-source models (DeepSeek, Llama) for air-gapped enterprise customers
requirements:
Must Have
4+ years of software engineering experience with strong proficiency in Python
1+ year of hands-on experience building LLM-powered agent systems — not chatbots, but agents that reason, plan, use tools, and take multi-step actions
Deep working knowledge of at least one agentic framework: LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen, or equivalent
Experience with tool-calling / function-calling patterns, including dynamic tool selection and chaining
Solid understanding of prompt engineering for complex reasoning tasks — chain-of-thought, ReAct, plan-and-execute patterns
Experience integrating with multiple LLM providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google) and managing model-agnostic abstractions
Ability to build robust, production-grade systems — not just prototypes. You think about failure modes, retries, timeouts, guardrails, and observability
Strong fundamentals in distributed systems, async programming, and API design
Strong Plus
Background in cybersecurity — offensive (pentesting, vulnerability assessment, red teaming) or defensive (SOC operations, SIEM, detection engineering, incident response)
Familiarity with MITRE ATT&CK framework, Sigma rules, or detection-as-code practices
Experience deploying and fine-tuning open-source LLMs (Llama, DeepSeek, Mistral) for onpremise or air-gapped environments
Knowledge of graph databases (Neo4j) for modeling attack paths or entity relationships
Experience building multi-agent systems where multiple specialized agents collaborate, delegate, and share context
Familiarity with RAG pipelines, vector databases, and knowledge retrieval systems
Mindset
You're excited about building AI systems that take real action in the world, not just generate text
You have a strong security intuition — you think about what can go wrong, what an adversary would do, and where guardrails are needed
You're comfortable with ambiguity and can translate vague domain requirements into concrete agent behaviors
You care about reliability over cleverness — a working agent that handles edge cases beats a flashy demo
benefits:
Opportunity to build AI agent systems for two products simultaneously — offensive and defensive security — a rare engineering challenge
Direct influence on product architecture and AI strategy from day one
Work with a team that understands both security and AI deeply
Competitive compensation

title: Product Engineer (Fresher & Junior)
address: 39 Nguyễn Duy Hiệu, An Khanh, Ho Chi Minh
reasons:
Own critical product surfaces end‑to‑end
Build real revenue engines with AI and data
Hybrid, async work that respects working style
description:
About Flexspace AI
Flexspace AI is the e-commerce + AI revenue platform for coworking — / Shopify / Airbnb for flexible workspace. Seed-funded. We turn operators' websites into high-converting storefronts and run AI agents that price and market their inventory in real time.
What we ship
: mobile-first booking engine that embeds in any operator's site; SmartPricing Agent for dynamic pricing on meeting rooms, day passes, offices; SmartMarketing Agent for promo campaigns; operator dashboard for revenue/bookings/attribution; member portal for end customers; two-way integrations with prominent property management systems.
Who buys it
: coworking operators from single-location indies to multi-country brands. Their revenue is the conversion rate of the screens you'll design — CTAs, catalog, transitions, and checkout aren't decoration here; they're the product.
How we work
: small, agile, AI-heavy. On track to profitability this year. Headcount is deliberately small so each person owns real surface area — tight feedback loops, no bureaucracy, no committees. We measure shipped work — funnel lifts, partner themes shipped, UX issues triaged — not hours. No face-time theater.
Co-located hybrid out of Workflow Thao Dien in HCMC for in-person speed. Wider team is async-first, written-first across US, Israel, Turkey, Philippines, and Vietnam. Weekly product/design sync with the CTO/cofounder — no layers between you and the people deciding what to build.
Role Overview
Product Engineer building the e-commerce platform behind the next generation of coworking spaces—SmartPricing, SmartMarketing, the booking engine operators embed on their sites, and the integrations that tie it all together. You work directly with the founders, with no layers between you and the people setting the roadmap. We also welcome final-year students looking for an internship.
What engineering means here.
The hard problem isn't writing code—AI writes plenty of it now. It's deciding what's worth building. Operators juggle hundreds of spaces, prices, members, bookings, and integrations across locations and time zones; customers comparing meeting rooms decide in seconds. Your job is to understand these humans—in the data—then ship software that moves their revenue. Empathy and data are the input; working product is the output. Polish comes last.
On prioritization.
Not all code has the same payoff. You'll look at a problem from several angles—funnel data, operator feedback, revenue, churn signals—and pick the work where your hours move the business most. A feature nobody uses is wasted hours; a 2% lift on the booking funnel is the company's quarter. Judgment over completeness.
On decisions.
Bigger calls go to the team before you build. Smaller calls—ship, watch the data, iterate. We're data-driven, not opinion-driven, and seniority doesn't win arguments—evidence does. You'll own the surfaces you touch, with support, and you expose your reasoning so we can calibrate together.
On growth.
You're early-career, and we hire for that on purpose. Expect code review, pairing, and direct coaching from founders and senior engineers. We can teach the stack, the patterns, and the product thinking. The one thing we can't give you is drive—that comes from you.
What You'll Do
Ship features end-to-end.
Work with founders and operators to understand a need, then spec, build, and release it—with support along the way.
Build and evolve our SmartPricing & SmartMarketing agents.
Pricing rules, targeting logic, and performance monitoring.
Make booking effortless.
Seamless booking experiences with instant payment, embedded right in operators' websites.
Wire up integrations.
Sync data with coworking CRMs, inventory systems, and analytics tools—and prevent double bookings.
Pull data, form an opinion, decide.
Revenue, Mixpanel, GA4 / GTM funnel data, and operator feedback.
Write so the team stays in sync.
Clear specs and pull-request descriptions that keep an async, distributed team aligned across time zones.
How You'll Work With AI
Claude as peers, not novelties. You'll write and refine structured prompts, build new ones, and ship real changes through AI tools. Senior engineers coach you and set guardrails so you can move fast without first becoming a framework expert. Judgment, taste, and clear thinking are the bottleneck now—not syntax. We give you a budget for the best AI tools because we expect you to use them as leverage, not as a crutch.
What Success Looks Like In Your First 6 Months
You've shipped real features to production that operators and members actually use.
You can navigate the codebase and pick up unfamiliar areas without much hand-holding.
You ship changes through Claude with sound judgment about what to accept and what to rework.
You back your decisions and pushback with data—and your written updates keep the async team moving without meetings.
You're catching product, UX, and trade-off issues early, not just implementing tickets.
What Makes You a Great Fit
We prioritize these qualities top-down—technical skills can be learned quickly by sharp, curious people with low ego and a strong work ethic. Above all, here's what we look for:
Drive and motivation.
We can give you the tools, the environment, and hands-on coaching—but we can't give you the drive to succeed as a product engineer in the modern AI era. That has to come from you.
Attention to detail and high standards.
You're obsessed with quality—it's not about just getting the job done, it's about delivering the best work you can and raising the team's bar. You sweat the small things—edge cases, copy, data correctness—because details separate a working product from a trusted one.
Clear written English.
You read and write clear English (with the help with AI tools); in an async, globally distributed team, your writing is how you think, collaborate, and lead.
High agency.
You take initiative—ask questions when something's unclear, chase down answers, and push your work forward instead of waiting to be told the next step.
You question everything.
Everyone has a voice and is expected to push the envelope. There's no "the senior person knows better"—answers and pushback alike are grounded in data and critical thinking, regardless of title or age.
Curiosity and fast learning.
You pick up new domains, tools, and concepts quickly, especially around AI, pricing, and B2B SaaS.
Product sense.
You care about customers and business context, not just the tech stack, and you treat engineering as a way to drive revenue, bookings, and occupancy. You grasp basic microeconomics—incentives, opportunity cost, supply and demand—as a toolkit for trade-offs: simpler designs that still maximize value, arguments made in terms of impact rather than opinion, and an understanding of why the business prioritizes what it does. Don't have this thinking framework yet? If you bring the motivation, we'll coach you on it.

title: Product Engineer (Insurtech SaaS, Golang, AI)
address: Sàn văn phòng số 12A01 – Trung tâm thương mại Chợ Mơ, số 459C phố Bạch Mai, Bach Mai, Ha Noi
description:
About the job
Product Engineer
AI-first engineering, uncompromising fundamentals. Accountable for the outcome, not the output.
Full-time · On-site · Flexible working hours · Distributed, multi-timezone team · AI-first engineering · 3+ years experience
The role is remote from your start date and becomes hybrid when our new office opens, expected around 20 December
Job Summary
We are hiring a
Product Engineer
- an engineer accountable for
outcomes, not output
.
We do not measure engineers by tickets closed or lines shipped. We measure them by whether the thing they built actually solved the user's problem. That means you will be expected to question requirements before building them, own a feature from ambiguity through to production behaviour, and stay attached to it after release - watching the metrics, the logs, and the support tickets.
You will work with
Product Managers, designers, and business stakeholders based in different countries and timezones
. Overlap hours are limited by design, so clear communication and the ability to move a decision forward asynchronously - without waiting for a meeting - matter as much as your engineering skill.
This is a
deeply technical role with an AI-first mindset
. AI coding agents are the default way we build here - you will spend more of your day designing architecture, steering agents, and reviewing generated code than typing implementations by hand. We expect fluency with spec-driven development, reusable agent skills, and context engineering, not occasional autocomplete use.
Which is exactly why fundamentals and best practices matter more, not less
, so you will be held to a high bar on SOLID, Clean Architecture, design patterns, distributed system design, relational data modelling, and automation testing: these are working knowledge, not résumé keywords, and you should expect to defend your choices reasonably in code review and in the interview.
You remain the author of record for everything that lands in main.
"The agent wrote it" is never an acceptable explanation for a defect.
Key Responsibilities
Own the outcome.
Take a business problem from vague to shipped to
measured
. Define what success looks like with your Product Manager, instrument for it, and act on what the data says - including rolling back or rewriting your own work when the numbers disagree with the plan.
Find the problem, not just the solution.
Interrogate requirements before implementing them. Surface the cheaper path, the edge case nobody scoped, and the feature that shouldn't be built. Say so early and in writing.
Collaborate across borders and timezones.
Partner directly with Product Managers, designers, QA, and business stakeholders distributed across multiple countries. Write decisions down, keep specs and PR descriptions self-explanatory, unblock people in other timezones, and run the occasional early or late call when the others need it.
Architect and build services and APIs.
Design RESTful (and where appropriate, event-driven or gRPC) services applying SOLID, Clean/Hexagonal Architecture, and design patterns deliberately - with a clear justification for the boundaries you draw. Design normalised, indexed, migration-safe relational schemas that hold up under real query load. Architecture is the part an agent cannot infer for you: you set the boundaries and the contracts, then let agents fill them in.
Design for distribution.
Make grounded calls on monolith vs. microservices. Build services that satisfy 12-factor principles - externalised config, stateless processes, disposability, dev/prod parity - and containerise them for Docker/Kubernetes deployment.
Automate the safety net.
Own automated testing for what you build: unit, integration, contract, and end-to-end where it earns its keep. Tests ship in the same PR as the code, not in a follow-up ticket. A bug fix without a reproducing test is not a fix. In an AI-first workflow the test suite
is
the specification - it is what makes agent-generated change safe to merge at speed.
Work AI-first, and hold the line on quality.
Drive delivery with coding agents, know your acceptance criteria first, let agents execute, then review hard. Build and maintain reusable agent skills, project instructions, and guardrails so the whole team gains leverage - not just your own throughput. Reject output that is merely plausible: over-abstracted layers, duplicated logic, silently swallowed errors, tests that assert nothing. Never merge code you cannot explain line by line.
Run what you ship.
Instrument services with structured logging, metrics, and tracing. Debug production incidents, write the postmortem, and close the loop with a fix that prevents recurrence.
Raise the team's bar.
Review peers' PRs substantively, document trade-offs and decisions, and mentor on fundamentals and on responsible AI-assisted workflows.
requirements:
Job Requirements
3+ years
building and operating production backend services - and you can walk through a system you designed, why you designed it that way, and what you'd change now.
Deep, demonstrable command of software design fundamentals:
OOP, SOLID, Clean Architecture, and design patterns. You will be asked to critique a design and explain what breaks at scale. This is the non-negotiable core of the role - in an AI-first team, fundamentals are the review capability that keeps agent velocity from becoming agent debt.
Strong RESTful API design:
resource modelling, versioning, idempotency, pagination, error contracts, authentication/authorisation.
Strong relational database design
(PostgreSQL/MySQL): normalisation and when to break it, indexing strategy, transactions and isolation levels, query analysis, safe schema migrations.
Microservices and 12-factor apps:
service boundaries, inter-service communication, failure isolation, configuration and secrets management - plus honest judgment on when a monolith is the correct answer.
Automation testing discipline:
you write tests first or alongside, understand the test pyramid, and use test doubles without mocking away the thing under test. You treat coverage as a floor for confidence, never as a number to satisfy - and you can tell a genuine regression test from an agent-generated one that asserts nothing.
Containerisation:
confident with Docker; working knowledge of Kubernetes (deployments, services, config/secrets, health probes, resource limits).
An AI-first way of working, already in your hands:
real production experience with Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or equivalent - including spec/context engineering, agent skills or custom commands, and a disciplined self-review process before any PR. You should be able to describe a time an agent produced plausible-but-wrong code, how you caught it, and which fundamental (a design principle, a data-model rule, a failing test) let you catch it.
Product mindset with real ownership instincts:
comfortable with ambiguity, able to talk to non-engineers about trade-offs in their language, and biased toward shipping something small to learn rather than debating something large.
Effective asynchronous, cross-cultural collaboration:
professional written English, the discipline to document context for people who are asleep when you're working, and comfort operating with stakeholders in several countries and timezones.
Working frontend ability
- React, Next.js, or Vue - enough to build and ship a full user-facing slice yourself.
Nice to Have
Golang
- our preferred backend language for new services.
gRPC
and
HTTP/2
, including streaming and
Server-Sent Events (SSE)
for real-time and AI-streaming interfaces.
ReactJS / NextJS
at depth - SSR/RSC, routing, data fetching, performance.
CI/CD pipeline
ownership (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or similar) including automated quality and security gates.
Infrastructure as Code
- Terraform, Pulumi, or Helm.
Service observability and SRE practice
- OpenTelemetry, APM (Datadog / New Relic / Grafana stack), SLOs and error budgets, on-call and incident response.
Message queues, background job processing, and event-driven architectures.
SaaS products, media streaming (HLS/M3U8), or prior experience in a distributed international team.

A genuinely international team - you'll work with product and business colleagues across multiple countries.

description:
About the Role
You will own bonbon shop, our B2B platform connecting brands with retail outlets. That means owning the backlog, the requirements, and what gets shipped. You will work closely with the Product Manager on the product's direction and on key decisions with enterprise clients.
Every enterprise client runs their business differently, and each will ask for things the product can't do yet. We see these requests as the best source of insight into what the product should become. If you enjoy turning real client problems into product capabilities, you will thrive here.
How this role runs
Outcomes over output.
The roadmap is measured by activation, retention, and revenue, not by how many features we ship.
Data drives priorities.
We decide what to build based on usage data: funnels, session recordings, and where users drop off.
AI where it matters.
We apply AI to workflows with heavy manual effort, and keep simple flows simple.
Build once, serve many.
When a client asks for something, your job is to turn it into a capability that other clients can use too.
Key Responsibilities
1. Roadmap and Backlog
Own the roadmap across activation, engagement, retention, and monetization
Own and prioritize the product backlog by value, data, and business impact
Set the success metric for every initiative before work begins
2. Client Requirements and Platform Decisions
Serve multiple enterprise clients with different ways of working on one platform, without splitting the product into separate versions
Turn repeated requests into configuration. Build the flexibility before the third client asks for it
Propose what becomes a platform capability, what becomes configuration, and what gets declined
Keep client commitments and roadmap work both on schedule
3. Trade Marketing and Brand Programs
Own the part of the product that lets Trade Marketing and Marketing run programs directly with retailers: loyalty mechanics, promotion execution, sell-out campaigns, brand activation at outlet level
Give brand managers a clear view of program performance, including whether retailer behavior changed
Work with Sales and Professional Services (PS) to find where programs break in the field, and fix the cause in the product
4. Data, Behavior and AI
Own the product analytics: funnels, cohorts, activation events, drop-off points, and add the events we are missing
Run experiments, watch session recordings, talk to users in the field, and write down what you learned
Find the repetitive, low-value steps done by retailers, sales reps, and brand teams, and propose AI-assisted alternatives
5. Working with the Teams
Spend around 30% of your time with clients: meetings, workshops, and field visits, including travel outside HCMC
Set expectations with clients, Sales, Trade Marketing, and management on what ships, when, and what does not
With Project Managers: the PM decides project scope and timeline, you decide the product. Raise conflicts early
With R&D (BA and development team): own requirements, priorities, and acceptance. Drive Agile delivery by running the sprint and ceremonies yourself
requirements:
3+ years as a Product Owner, Product Manager, or Senior BA on a B2B software product, managing and prioritizing the backlog across discovery, delivery, and iteration in an Agile/Scrum environment
Experience in
distribution, retail, FMCG, pharma, or Trade Marketing program execution
, with working knowledge of multi-tier distribution (brand → distributor → retailer) and how trade promotions are funded, run, and measured
Writes clear user stories and acceptance criteria that engineers can build from with minimal clarification
Comfortable balancing conflicting requirements from multiple enterprise clients, both in meetings and on field visits to distributors and retailers
Able to read product data and act on it: funnels, cohorts, drop-off points, and the results of simple experiments.
Strong Plus
Experience building or owning a product for distribution, retail, FMCG, or pharma businesses
Experience working on a platform connecting brands to retailers (loyalty, promotions, or trade incentives)
Experience building AI features into a shipped product
Familiarity with OMS, POS, DMS, or similar platforms

Full social and health insurance under Vietnamese labor law
You own a product used by brands and retail outlets across Vietnam, working directly with the Chairman and Head of R&D.
A clear path from mid-level to owning the product on your own
Decisions get made in days, not in committee. You will see your work in front of clients within the quarter

title: Middle Python AI Cloud Engineer (Azure , PostgreSQL)
address: Tầng 8, tòa nhà Licogi 13, số 164 Khuất Duy Tiến, Phường Thanh Xuân, Ha Noi
description:
ROLE OVERVIEW
We are looking for a proactive, skilled, and detail-oriented Python AI Cloud Engineer – Azure (Middle) with 3 to 5 years of commercial software engineering experience to expand our Platform Engineering team. In this role, you will design, build, and operate Python serverless workflows on Azure Durable Functions and production AI agents on Microsoft Foundry and LangGraph, running inside a complex, network-isolated enterprise Azure landing zone.
You will own long-running orchestrations, agentic workflows, and event-driven integrations end to end, connecting internal enterprise tools, Microsoft 365, and our central SAP ERP system. You will build the agent harness around our models (tools, memory, guardrails, evaluation, and observability) and work hands-on with the infrastructure underneath it all: hub-and-spoke virtual networks, private endpoints, hybrid connectivity to on-premises systems, identity, and governance.
YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES
Durable Functions Development: Design and build Python workflows on Azure Functions and Durable Functions (orchestrator, activity, and entity functions) using patterns such as function chaining, fanout/fan-in, async HTTP APIs, monitors, and human interaction, with idempotent activities, retry policies, and safe versioning of long-running orchestrations.
Backend & API Development: Build and maintain Python services and REST APIs (FastAPI, Azure Functions HTTP triggers) exposed through Azure API Management, with typed, tested, and documented code (type hints, Pydantic, OpenAPI).
AI Agents & Agent Harness: Design and operate production AI agents with LangGraph and Microsoft Foundry (Foundry Agent Service, Azure OpenAI and other Foundry models), including the agent harness around them: tool / function calling against internal and SAP APIs, MCP servers, state and memory, multi-agent orchestration, human-in-the-loop approvals, and durable long-running agent execution on Durable Functions.
RAG, Evaluation & Responsible AI: Build retrieval pipelines on Azure AI Search (hybrid / vector search, chunking, embeddings), set up offline and online evaluations and tracing in Foundry, and apply guardrails (Azure AI Content Safety, prompt-injection defenses, data-access boundaries); manage model deployments, quotas, latency, and token cost through private, Entra ID-secured Foundry endpoints.
Cloud Infrastructure & Networking: Provision and operate a complex Azure landing zone with Bicep or Terraform: hub-and-spoke VNets, subnets and NSGs, Private Endpoints and Private DNS zones, VNet integration for Functions Premium / Flex Consumption plans, Azure Firewall, Application Gateway / Front Door with WAF, and hybrid connectivity (VPN Gateway / ExpressRoute) to on-premises systems, applying Azure Well-Architected Framework principles.
Security, Identity & Governance: Secure workloads with Microsoft Entra ID, Managed Identities, Azure Key Vault, Azure RBAC, and Azure Policy; enforce least-privilege access and private-only connectivity across subscriptions and environments.
SAP & Enterprise Integration: Design, deploy, and monitor integration pipelines connecting internal applications to SAP S/4HANA / ECC and Microsoft 365 via OData (v2/v4), REST APIs, Azure Service Bus, Event Grid, and Logic Apps.
CI/CD, Quality & Observability: Build and maintain Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions pipelines for infrastructure and application deployments (environment promotion, staged / slot-based rollouts); maintain high test coverage with pytest; and implement structured logging, distributed tracing, dashboards, and alerting with Application Insights, Azure Monitor, and OpenTelemetry.
requirements:
Must-have
Python: Strong commercial experience with modern Python (3.10+), including asyncio, type hints, packaging and dependency management (uv, Poetry, or pip), and testing with pytest.
Azure Functions & Durable Functions: Hands-on commercial experience building and operating Azure Functions in Python, including Durable Functions orchestrations in production, with a solid understanding of their constraints (deterministic orchestrator code, replay, idempotency, task hub storage, scaling, and hosting plans).
AI Agents & LLM Engineering: Commercial experience shipping LLM-powered applications or agents to production in Python with LangGraph (or LangChain, Microsoft Agent Framework, Semantic Kernel), including tool calling, structured outputs, RAG, and systematic evaluation, plus hands-on experience with Microsoft Foundry / Azure OpenAI model deployments.
Azure Infrastructure & Networking: Proven experience setting up and troubleshooting non-trivial Azure environments (VNets, subnets, NSGs, Private Endpoints, Private DNS, VNet integration, routing and firewalls, hybrid connectivity) using infrastructure as code with Bicep or Terraform.
API Design & Integration: Proven track record in designing, documenting (OpenAPI/Swagger), consuming, and securing RESTful APIs, webhooks, and message-based integrations (Service Bus, Event Grid, Storage queues).
Databases: Strong practical experience with relational databases (Azure SQL Database, Azure Database for PostgreSQL), schema migrations (e.g., Alembic), query performance tuning, and Python data access (SQLAlchemy, pyodbc, or psycopg).
Nice-to-have
AI-102 (Azure AI Engineer Associate) certification.
Microsoft Azure certifications such as AZ-204 (Azure Developer Associate), AZ-104 (Azure Administrator), AZ-700 (Azure Network Engineer Associate), or AZ-400 (DevOps Engineer Expert).
Authentication and authorization with Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), app registrations, MSAL, Managed Identities, Azure RBAC, PIM, and Azure Policy.
Azure Landing Zones: Experience with the Cloud Adoption Framework, multi-subscription hub-andspoke or Azure Virtual WAN designs, and management-group level governance.
Advanced Durable Functions: Experience with the Durable Task Scheduler or alternative storage providers (MSSQL, Netherite), Durable Entities for stateful coordination, and performance tuning of high-volume orchestrations.
Enterprise & SAP Integration: Hands-on experience or solid working knowledge of enterprise application integration, particularly with SAP (OData v2/v4, REST endpoints, SAP Gateway, or BAPI/RFC) or similar ERPs, including via Azure Integration Services (Logic Apps SAP connector, API Management, On-premises Data Gateway).
Experience with Docker and containerized workloads on Azure Container Apps or AKS.
Basic frontend experience (e.g., React) for building internal admin pages and operations dashboards.
Agent Harness Engineering: Experience building agent runtimes or harnesses: tool sandboxing, context and memory management, retries and checkpointing, cost / token budgets, and agent observability with OpenTelemetry GenAI tracing or LangSmith.
Experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP), Agent-to-Agent (A2A) protocols, or Microsoft 365 Copilot / Teams agent extensibility.
Experience with private networking for AI services (Foundry and Azure AI Search behind Private Endpoints, API Management as an AI gateway with token limits and load balancing).
CORE TECHNOLOGY STACK
Compute & Backend: Python 3.11+, Azure Functions (Python v2 programming model), Azure Durable Functions (orchestrator, activity & entity functions), FastAPI, Azure Container Apps, Azure App Service.
AI & Agents: Microsoft Foundry (Azure AI Foundry) & Foundry Agent Service, Azure OpenAI models, LangGraph / LangChain, Microsoft Agent Framework / Semantic Kernel, Model Context Protocol (MCP), Azure AI Search (vector & hybrid search), Azure AI Content Safety, Foundry evaluations & tracing.
Data, Storage & Messaging: Azure SQL Database, Azure Database for PostgreSQL, Cosmos DB, Blob / Table / Queue Storage, Azure Cache for Redis, Service Bus, Event Grid, Event Hubs.
Networking & Infrastructure: Hub-and-spoke Virtual Networks, Private Endpoints & Private DNS Zones, VNet Integration, NSGs, Azure Firewall, Application Gateway / Front Door (WAF), VPN Gateway / ExpressRoute, Functions Premium / Flex Consumption plans.
Enterprise & Integration: SAP S/4HANA / ECC, SAP OData, Azure API Management, Logic Apps, Microsoft Graph API, Microsoft Teams.
Security & Identity: Microsoft Entra ID, Managed Identities, Azure Key Vault, Azure RBAC, Azure Policy, OAuth 2.0, OIDC, Microsoft Defender for Cloud
DevOps, Testing & Tooling: Azure DevOps, Bicep, Azure CLI, Docker, pytest, uv, Application Insights, Azure Monitor, OpenTelemetry.
benefits:

Enterprise-Scale Impact: Build tools directly impacting hundreds of daily internal users and missioncritical enterprise workflows.
Professional Growth: Dedicated annual learning stipend for cloud and AI certifications (Microsoft Azure, SAP), international tech and AI conferences, and internal tech talks.

description:
BLogic Systems
builds POS systems for the U.S. restaurant and bar market.
Our product team in Ho Chi Minh City works directly with our US-based team, and our software runs live in restaurants across the United States — quality issues reach real customers immediately.
We are hiring for two levels: a Fullstack Leader to take charge of the technical direction and delivery of the fullstack team, and a Senior Fullstack Engineer to strengthen the team's core. The Leader role is a strategic position for someone with 6+ years of experience, including proven experience leading an engineering team. Strong Senior candidates without management experience are also encouraged to apply for the Senior track.
1. Fullstack Development (both levels)
Design and implement robust, scalable and high-performance server-side logic with .NET 8+ (and .NET Framework for legacy modules), exposing clean RESTful APIs.
Build new features with Angular (v18+), TypeScript and Tailwind CSS, following Clean Architecture and component-based design.
Handle complex asynchronous data streams and state management with RxJS (switchMap, combineLatest, custom operators).
Work with SQL Server and PostgreSQL. Diagnose and resolve performance bottlenecks across the stack (application code, SQL queries, frontend rendering) so the system handles high concurrent loads smoothly.
Use CapacitorJS where applicable to share web code with our mobile apps.
Work closely with Product Owners, BAs, QA, Mobile and POS teams to define clear API contracts and data models.
2. Architecture & Quality Ownership
Contribute to system design and architectural decisions (Senior); own the technical direction and architecture across the product line (Leader), applying Clean Architecture, DDD or CQRS where the business logic calls for it.
Treat business-critical flows (order submission, payment, surcharge / dual pricing, receipt printing, offline mode, backward compatibility between POS versions) as production-critical: a one-cent discrepancy is an incident, not a minor bug.
Own the quality of what you ship. Bugs found by customers, IT Support or leadership instead of by automated tests and code review are your primary KPI (Leader: for the whole team).
Maintain and improve CI/CD pipelines and cloud-based services (AWS/Azure), with clear quality gates before anything reaches production.
3. Team Leadership & Delivery (Leader track; Senior supports)
Lead, mentor and develop the fullstack team; set KPIs and career development plans for each member. Senior engineers mentor junior members through thorough code reviews.
Define coding standards, testing practices and best practices, and drive them across the team.
Turn requirements from Product Owners and BAs into clear tasks, estimate and plan sprints, and manage priorities, risks and delivery commitments across projects and releases.
Coordinate with the QA, Mobile and POS teams and with US-based stakeholders.
Establish and enforce release readiness: nothing goes to production without meeting clear quality criteria. You have the authority to hold a release.
Take part in hiring and onboarding, and build a collaborative, high-performing team.
Stay hands-on: keep coding on critical features, so your decisions stay grounded in the real codebase.
4. AI-Driven Engineering
Use AI coding agents in daily work (code generation, refactoring, test writing, code review, debugging, documentation) to raise productivity, while owning the quality and security of everything you ship.
Leader: define and roll out how the team works with AI: agent roles and skills, a shared agent harness, verification loops, and AI code review in the pull-request flow.
Stay up to date with .NET, Angular and AI tooling, and share ideas on how to apply them in our products.
requirements:
Must have
Experience:
4+ years of professional experience in fullstack development, with a proven track record of designing and delivering large-scale systems. For the Leader track: 6+ years, including 2+ years leading a team or acting as a tech lead (required for Leader, a plus for Senior).
Proficiency in C#, ASP.NET Core, Entity Framework Core and Dapper. Strong understanding of OOP, SOLID and Design Patterns.
Database design and advanced SQL optimization on SQL Server and PostgreSQL (indexing, execution plans).
Strong JavaScript and TypeScript, HTML and CSS (Tailwind CSS preferred), with hands-on experience in Angular and RxJS. You produce clean, efficient, scalable and well-documented code that follows coding standards.
Familiarity with distributed systems and message brokers (RabbitMQ, Kafka or AWS SQS).
Experience with unit testing (xUnit/NUnit) and automated testing strategies.
Understanding of frontend performance optimization and web security (XSS, CSRF, authentication flows).
Experience with systems that handle money: you know why a one-cent discrepancy in a payment flow is an incident.
Strong root cause analysis skills: you go beyond fixing the symptom to understanding why it happened.
Leader track: strong architecture skills (able to make and defend design decisions and balance speed, quality and technical debt), people management, agile delivery, estimation, and stakeholder communication.
The professional confidence to hold a release that does not meet quality criteria, even under schedule pressure.
English: Upper-Intermediate (reading and writing). You must be comfortable working with US-based documentation and requirements; the ability to communicate directly with our US team is required for Leader.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
Passion for programming and solving complex problems, a can-do attitude, and strong teamwork.
Working with AI — required, not optional
Proficient, hands-on experience with AI coding agents in daily development work.
Able to set up an AI agent team: define agent roles, skills and gates so a feature can be split across several agents and still come back consistent.
Proficient in prompt engineering: you can turn a vague requirement into instructions an agent executes reliably, and keep it on the project's conventions.
Experience setting up an agent harness: project-level instruction files, custom commands and skills, sub-agents with scoped tools and permissions, and hooks for the rules that must always hold.
Loop engineering:
you build an objective verifier and let the agent iterate against it instead of reviewing output by eye. On the back end that means unit tests, type checks and architecture or lint gates; turning a rule you would otherwise repeat in code review into an automated check is the core skill. On the front end it means more than "it compiles": you also give the agent a way to observe the rendered result (for example a browser-automation screenshot or an accessibility snapshot). Candidates who have closed that visual loop are rare and we want them.
Experience setting up AI code review: automated review in the pull-request flow, tuned so it catches real defects instead of producing noise everyone learns to ignore.
Experience building an autonomous agent team (agents that plan, implement, review and verify, with a human at the gates) is a strong advantage.
Critical evaluation of AI output:
you can spot a diff that looks correct and quietly breaks a business rule, and a component that renders fine in the demo and falls apart on real data or a slow network.
You are empowered by AI, and you are accountable for everything it produces on your behalf.
This is the single most important expectation of the role. We want you to lean on AI heavily; "the AI wrote it" is never an explanation for a defect that reached production.

Annual salary review
Premium health insurance
Access to AI tools for daily work and career growth

Free coffee

description:
VoiceAI builds the real-time voice layer behind Trusting Social's AI agents, for both outbound and inbound calls. We own the cascade pipeline that connects the caller to the agent (ASR → LLM → TTS): real-time speech understanding (ASR), real-time speech generation (TTS), the real-time orchestration between speech and the LLM script, and the interaction behaviour on top, including turn-taking, latency, and answering machine detection. Our platform powers Kompato (AI collections for US fintech lenders) and Sophia (financial services sales in Vietnam and the Philippines), working closely with the Collin and Sophia DS and product teams, who own the LLM dialogue scripts, and the engineering team, who owns telephony and inbound routing and connects to our layer through the same interface for inbound and outbound calls.
About the role
This is a senior, fully hands-on role. You will own a full area of the VoiceAI platform end to end, such as real-time speech generation, speech understanding, or pipeline orchestration quality. You will solve ambiguous problems independently, set the technical approach for your area, and mentor the people working on it.

Own a full area of the VoiceAI platform end-to-end, from research and modelling to deployment and production monitoring

Design the evaluation methods for your area: offline benchmarks, TTS arenas, audio-based judges, human rating programs, and online A/B testing
Own production quality and reliability for your area, with monitoring and alerting that catch regressions before callers hear them
Mentor data scientists and engineers, and lead technical reviews
Partner with the Collin and Sophia DS and product teams and with engineering; present evidence-first findings and trade-offs to senior stakeholders

title: Senior Data Engineer/Data Platform Engineer
address: Floor 4, SFC Building, 9 Dinh Tien Hoang, Sai Gon, Ho Chi Minh
description:
About AIRR Labs:
Founded in 2019 and headquartered in Singapore, AIRR Labs is a leading e-commerce enabler in Southeast Asia for FMCG, Beauty and Lifestyle brands. We have 350+ people across Thailand, the Philippines, Vietnam, Malaysia and Singapore, with our technology hub in Vietnam. We are a certified TikTok Strategic Agency, Shopee Premium Enabler and Lazada Star Enabler, and we partner with brands such as Unilever, Colgate-Palmolive, Estée Lauder and Adidas.
About the Role:
We are turning AIRR's data into a platform. Today, data from TikTok Shop, Shopee, Lazada, livestream, media and fulfilment sits across tools and teams. The Centralized Data Platform (CDP) unifies it into one trusted layer. Every team and client consumes it as a service through APIs and MCP, never through ad-hoc exports.
You will be the senior engineer who builds that platform. You will set the standards, ship the core pipelines and launch the serving layer that our commerce, media and AI products run on.
Share of work:
Data architecture (35%):
Unified data model across marketplaces, brands and markets; architecture standards; data contracts with source teams.
Data engineering (35%):
ELT pipelines, marketplace API ingestion, transformation logic, data quality on TB-scale datasets.
Data serving (20%):
API and MCP layer so internal teams, clients and AI agents consume data as a service.
Platform reliability (10%):
Uptime, observability, incident response, cost control.
What You'll Do:
Architect the CDP:
Design the core data model (orders, products, creators, campaigns, livestreams, inventory) across TikTok Shop, Shopee, Lazada and five markets.
Set the standards:
Define naming conventions, layering (raw → clean → serving), documentation and data contracts that source teams sign up to.
Build the pipelines:
Ingest marketplace and internal APIs at scale on AWS (S3, Lambda) and SingleStore, handling rate limits, schema changes and late-arriving data.
Serve data as a product:
Build and own the API and MCP layer, with clear SLAs, versioning and access control, so consumers never query raw tables.
Guarantee trust:
Put automated data quality checks, lineage and observability in place; drive root-cause analysis on incidents.
Enable AI:
Shape a semantic layer that AI agents and ML use cases can query safely through MCP.
Partner across teams:
Work with product, software engineering, commercial and client teams to turn their data needs into platform capabilities.
requirements:
Must-haves:
6+ years in data engineering or data platform engineering, including at least one platform built from scratch.
Expert SQL and data modelling (dimensional, partitioning, performance tuning).
Hands-on AWS (S3, Lambda) and an analytical database (SingleStore, Snowflake, BigQuery, ClickHouse, Redshift or similar).
Orchestration (Airflow, Dagster or similar) and transformation tooling (dbt or similar).
Strong Python, including building data APIs (FastAPI, REST or GraphQL).
Data quality and observability practice: testing, monitoring, lineage.
Platform mindset: treats internal teams as customers, writes clear contracts and docs.
High ownership and comfort making architecture trade-offs independently.
Working English for regional collaboration.
Nice-to-haves:
Experience with MCP, LLM tooling or semantic layers for AI agents.
Experience with e-commerce marketplace APIs (TikTok Shop, Shopee, Lazada) CDC or streaming (Kafka, Kinesis, Debezium).
Infrastructure as code (Terraform, CloudFormation).
Data governance and access control across multiple clients or brands.

A collaborative, innovative environment with opportunities for professional growth.

Chịu trách nhiệm chính (owner) về kiến trúc nền tảng dữ liệu (data warehouse/lakehouse): viết design doc, phân tích trade-off (batch và streaming, chi phí và độ trễ, build và buy) và bảo vệ phương án trước các bên liên quan.
Xây dựng mô hình dữ liệu (dimensional modeling, star schema, SCD) cho các nghiệp vụ đặc thù bán lẻ: fact giao dịch bán hàng theo dòng hóa đơn, snapshot tồn kho theo ngày/cửa hàng/SKU, đơn mua hàng và nhập kho, hủy hàng, hiệu quả chương trình khuyến mãi, khách hàng thành viên.
Định nghĩa các tầng dữ liệu (raw/staging/core/mart) và chuẩn đặt tên, phân vùng (partition), clustering, chính sách lưu trữ.
Đánh giá, lựa chọn công nghệ và đề xuất lộ trình phát triển nền tảng dữ liệu phù hợp với roadmap công ty.
2. Xây dựng & vận hành data pipeline
Thiết kế và phát triển pipeline ETL/ELT batch và real-time/near real-time thu thập dữ liệu từ POS, ERP (Microsoft Dynamics 365), hệ thống kho, e-commerce và các cơ sở dữ liệu nghiệp vụ (MongoDB, PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server).
Triển khai Change Data Capture (CDC) và streaming (Kafka, Debezium hoặc tương đương) để đồng bộ dữ liệu giữa các hệ thống; xử lý dữ liệu đến muộn (late-arriving data), bản ghi trùng lặp, thứ tự sự kiện và thay đổi schema từ nguồn (schema evolution).
Thống nhất data contract với các đội phát triển hệ thống nguồn: định nghĩa schema, quy trình thông báo và kiểm soát thay đổi để tránh làm gãy pipeline phía sau.
Điều phối và lập lịch luồng dữ liệu bằng công cụ orchestration (Airflow hoặc tương đương); xây dựng cơ chế retry, backfill, idempotency.
Phát triển lớp transformation bằng SQL/dbt; tối ưu hiệu năng truy vấn và chi phí xử lý trên cloud data warehouse (BigQuery hoặc tương đương).
3. Chất lượng, giám sát & quản trị dữ liệu
Xây dựng khung kiểm soát chất lượng dữ liệu (kiểm tra tính đầy đủ, duy nhất, hợp lệ) và cơ chế đối soát (reconciliation) số liệu kho dữ liệu với hệ thống nguồn, đặc biệt là doanh thu, tồn kho với số liệu Tài chính/ERP.
Định nghĩa và chịu trách nhiệm về SLO dữ liệu (độ tươi - freshness, độ đầy đủ - completeness, độ chính xác) cho các luồng dữ liệu quan trọng; thiết lập giám sát và cảnh báo tương ứng.
Dẫn dắt xử lý sự cố dữ liệu và thực hiện post-mortem (phân tích nguyên nhân gốc, hành động phòng ngừa).
Quản lý metadata, data catalog, data lineage và tài liệu hóa các luồng dữ liệu, bảng dữ liệu.
Triển khai phân quyền truy cập, bảo mật và che giấu dữ liệu nhạy cảm (PII), tuân thủ các quy định về bảo vệ dữ liệu cá nhân.
4. Kiểm thử, tự động hóa & tối ưu
Xây dựng chiến lược kiểm thử cho data pipeline: unit test cho logic xử lý, dbt tests/data tests cho mô hình dữ liệu, kiểm thử với bộ dữ liệu mẫu trước khi triển khai.
Áp dụng CI/CD cho data pipeline (test, review, deploy tự động) và quản lý cấu hình pipeline dưới dạng code.
Phối hợp với đội System trong việc triển khai, vận hành hạ tầng cho các dịch vụ dữ liệu (container, cloud resource); đội System chịu trách nhiệm hạ tầng nền tảng.
Theo dõi và tối ưu chi phí lưu trữ, tính toán trên nền tảng cloud.
5. Dẫn dắt & phối hợp
Làm việc với các phòng ban kinh doanh (Mua hàng, Vận hành, Marketing, Tài chính, Chuỗi cung ứng) để nắm bắt nhu cầu và chuyển hóa thành giải pháp dữ liệu.
Phối hợp với đội Data Analyst/BI để cung cấp data mart, semantic layer phục vụ dashboard và báo cáo; hỗ trợ đội Data Science về dữ liệu cho các bài toán dự báo nhu cầu, tối ưu tồn kho.
Phối hợp với đội Development và System để thống nhất cấu trúc dữ liệu nguồn và tích hợp hệ thống.
Hướng dẫn, review code và chia sẻ kiến thức cho các thành viên junior/middle; xây dựng tiêu chuẩn và best practices cho đội dữ liệu.
6. Kết quả kỳ vọng trong 6-12 tháng đầu
Chuẩn hóa các data mart cốt lõi (bán hàng, tồn kho, mua hàng, khuyến mãi) làm nguồn số liệu thống nhất cho toàn công ty.
Thiết lập SLO, giám sát và cơ chế đối soát tự động cho các luồng dữ liệu quan trọng; giảm rõ rệt số sự cố sai lệch số liệu.
Tối ưu chi phí truy vấn và lưu trữ trên data warehouse.
Hoàn thiện tài liệu, tiêu chuẩn phát triển và quy trình review để đội dữ liệu có thể mở rộng.
requirements:

title: Analytics Engineer (Data Engineer, Data Analyst)
address: 141-143 Nguyễn Cơ Thạch, Phường An Khánh, TP Hồ Chí Minh, Ho Chi Minh
reasons:
Attractive compensation & benefits
Shape personalization with 3B+ user data
Grow in a mature, data-driven LiveOps team
description:
About the role
We are looking for a proactive and forward-thinking Analytics Engineer to design, build, and scale our core data models, semantic layer, and AI-ready decision infrastructure across Amanotes.
In this role, you will bridge the gap between raw data pipelines built by Data Engineering and the analytical and operational needs of Product Managers, LiveOps, User Acquisition (UA), and Leadership. You will be responsible for transforming complex, high-volume player behavioral telemetry and business data into clean, well-documented, tested, and standardized dimensional models.
Beyond classical analytics engineering, you will pioneer the development of our "insight stack" — mapping data models and business questions into Model Context Protocol (MCP) tools and AI agent workflows, turning raw telemetry into reliable, automated, and self-serve business insights.
What you will do
1. Data Modeling & Semantic Layer Architecture & Maintenance
Design, build, and maintain production-grade dimensional data models in Google BigQuery using dbt, standardizing core metrics (UA, ad monetization, IAP, player engagement, and retention) into a trusted single source of truth.
Own and evolve the enterprise semantic layer across BI platforms (e.g., Metabase) and AI agent endpoints, preventing metric drift through clear versioning, deprecation policies, and canonical definitions.
Maintain model health, cost, and query performance: optimize BigQuery execution (partitioning, clustering, incremental builds) while ensuring data freshness SLAs and anomaly monitoring.
Enforce software engineering rigor across analytics: modular dbt development, automated CI/CD testing, Git version control, and peer code reviews.
2. Insight Stack & AI-Powered Decision Infrastructure
Collaborate with data leadership to design and evolve the "insight stack," connecting structured data assets to AI agents and Model Context Protocol (MCP) tools.
Translate recurring stakeholder decision flows (across Product, LiveOps, UA, and Management) into standardized inputs, queries, validation rules, and structured outputs for automated agent execution.
Build tool schemas, prompts, and execution flows enabling AI agents to query verified datasets, run comparative checks, and draft decision-ready summaries.
Establish guardrails, data validation, and permission boundaries ensuring AI agents operate safely without unmonitored raw database access.
3. Data Quality, Testing & Verification
Establish comprehensive automated testing frameworks (dbt tests, schema validation, data integrity rules) to safeguard data reliability and timeliness across all core data marts.
Define evaluation criteria and test suites to benchmark AI agent outputs against ground-truth queries, dashboards, and analyst outputs.
Build alerting and monitoring systems for data discrepancies, silent schema drift, and telemetry anomalies, driving swift incident resolution.
Document assumptions, data lineage, edge cases, and handoff criteria between automated agent analysis and human analyst deep-dives.
4. Data Governance, Catalog & Discoverability
Own and evolve the data catalog, managing metadata tags, descriptions, and ownership attributes across all modeled tables and views.
Curate and maintain the enterprise business glossary and canonical metric definitions, ensuring clear alignment between technical schemas and business context.
Maintain end-to-end data lineage from raw event telemetry to BI dashboards and AI agent endpoints to guarantee traceability and impact analysis.
Champion data governance policies, including access control tiers, data stewardship, and PII identification/masking.
5. Stakeholder Enablement & Collaboration
Partner closely with Data engineer to provide feedback on upstream data ingestion contracts, event tracking schemas, and warehouse performance optimization.
Empower Data Analysts, Product Owners, and Growth teams to self-serve trusted data through clean documentation, intuitive table design, and BI semantic layers (e.g., Metabase).
Act as an advocate for data literacy, reproducibility, and modern analytics engineering practices across the company.
requirements:
Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Engineering, or a related quantitative discipline (or equivalent practical experience).
3+ years of experience in Analytics Engineering, Data Engineering, or Advanced Data Analytics in a fast-paced environment.
Advanced proficiency in SQL and dimensional data modeling techniques (Kimball methodology, star/snowflake schemas, fact/dimension table design).
Hands-on experience with dbt (dbt Core or dbt Cloud) for data transformation, testing, documentation, and semantic layer modeling in production.
Proven track record of maintaining and governing a centralized semantic layer or metric store, including versioning, deprecation handling, and performance tuning.
Strong working knowledge of cloud data warehouses, preferably Google Cloud BigQuery.
Proficiency in Python for scripting, workflow automation, and integrating APIs/data services.
Experience with software engineering workflows: Git, version control, automated testing, and CI/CD pipelines.
Demonstrated experience with data governance, data catalogs, metadata management, and data lineage tools.
Fluency in English with strong written and verbal communication skills, capable of translating complex data architecture to non-technical stakeholders.
Nice to have
Experience in mobile gaming, adtech (mobile ad mediation, monetization, UA attribution), or consumer mobile applications at scale.
Familiarity with player telemetry tracking, in-game event design, or game analytics metrics.
Hands-on exposure to Model Context Protocol (MCP), LLM APIs, or AI agent frameworks for data analysis and querying.
Experience with workflow orchestration engines such as Apache Airflow or Google Cloud Composer.
Experience designing semantic layers and data exploration experiences in BI platforms such as Metabase, Tableau, or Looker.
Passion for mobile games and music technology.
